name: ESL MPSoC tile / bus architecture block
author: cp-4856 PoC graft (grounded in tsarilp-pub doc/common/tikzsetup.tex, not a fork of that file)
description: MPSoC-style tile/bus architecture figure: per-tile Core + Accelerator + config-register block joined by an intra-tile bus, two tiles joined by a dashed inter-tile NoC bus through a shared I/O terminal node. Colors are the ESL domain-semantic tokens (contract §2, ADR-0005 D7): core-accent=core/compute (Aquamarine), process-accent=datapath/accelerator (NavyBlue), param-accent=config/parameters (ForestGreen), intra-bus=Orange, inter-bus=NavyBlue, digitaldomain=terminal/IO (gray) -- extending opentikz's five-color ot* palette, not remapped onto it (see reference/color-palettes/color-palettes.md and cp-4856 learnings note on the palette-invariant collision).

parameters.name: \tilesep
parameters.meaning: horizontal gap between the two tile boundary boxes

parameters.name: \cfgonelabel
parameters.meaning: tile 0 config-register block label (use \\ for two lines)

parameters.name: \cfgtwolabel
parameters.meaning: tile 1 config-register block label (use \\ for two lines)

parameters.name: \interbuslabel
parameters.meaning: inter-tile bus caption above the I/O node

edit_contract.node_naming: cpu-core: (core1, core2); acc-core: (acc1, acc2); param-node: (cfg1, cfg2); tile: (tile1, tile2)

operations.summary: declare a node inside the tile with a role style (core/process/parameters), position it relative to an existing tile-local node, connect it with intrabus, then add it to that tile's fit=(...) list so the boundary re-encloses it

duplicate a tile's node block with a fresh index (3, 4, ...), position its fit node right=\tilesep cm of the previous tile, wire the shared io node to the new tile's fit.north, and extend the coordinate used for the interbus caption if more than two tiles are joined at the io hub

swap a node's style to change its role: core<->process<->parameters; each role keeps its own dedicated palette color per the domain-semantic scheme, so a role change also changes the color, never just the shape
adjust the tile's fit margins={left=...,right=...,top=...,bottom=...} values (grafted tikzsetup.tex pgfkeys helper) or extend which nodes are in its fit=(...) list

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role by re-binding that role's palette token (e.g. \colorlet{core-accent}{...}), never by editing the role's style to a raw color; keep intrabus=intra-bus, interbus=inter-bus-dashed, core=core-accent, process=process-accent, parameters=param-accent unless the family's settled-decisions record says otherwise (see cp-4856 note: this template has no settled-decisions record of its own yet — it is a PoC graft, not the shipped Phase-1 component library)

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration

hierarchy-is-organizer: explicit HIERARCHY/containment is the organizing primitive — tile ⊃ (pe | cpu-core | acc-core | mem-block); state the nesting explicitly so it is checkable and transfers to a nested-graph backend (ELK subgraphs, draw.io containers).
tiles-on-a-grid: tile containers are laid out on a regular grid (rows x columns), uniform size and gap; the grid is anchored once and every other tile placed relationally off it.
pes-inside-tiles: pe (and cpu-core / acc-core) nodes sit INSIDE their tile via the tile's fit/opts; a PE never floats outside the tile it belongs to.

tile-fit-declared-after-members: a tile's boundary fit node is declared AFTER every node it fits, inside an `on background layer` scope, so the tile box renders behind its members rather than occluding them.

ports-on-boundaries: buses attach at PORTS pinned on the tile/block BOUNDARY at the connection point; an inter-bus/NoC edge attaches to a tile's boundary port, never to a PE interior, and routes orthogonally from there.
intra-bus-stays-in-tile: intra-bus edges are SHORT and orthogonal, connecting PEs/mem within ONE tile only; they never cross a tile boundary.
noc-spine-between-tiles: the NoC / inter-bus is routed ORTHOGONALLY along the gaps between tile edges (a spine/mesh between tiles), connecting tile boundary ports, not PE interiors.
shared-memory-locus: shared-memory (mem-block) sits at ONE consistent locus across the set (e.g. a central spine or a fixed edge), the same place in every figure of the family.
legend-corner-groupbox: the legend is a group-box in a fixed corner, outside the tile grid; it never overlaps tiles or the NoC spine.
bus-color-split: intra-bus = Orange, inter-bus/NoC = NavyBlue (contract §2 tokens); consistent.

bus-dash-split: the inter-tile bus is ALWAYS dashed and the intra-tile bus is ALWAYS solid — this distinction is load-bearing (NoC/global vs. local/tile-internal traffic), independent of and in addition to the color split above.
core-accents: cpu-core = Aquamarine fill, acc-core = ForestGreen fill; PEs a light green.

palette-additive-not-remapped: the ESL domain-semantic tokens (core-accent/process-accent/param-accent/ intra-bus/inter-bus) are ADDITIVE to opentikz's five ot* names — never remapped onto or aliased through otblue/otorange/otteal/otpurple/otgray.
containment-is-membership: a node drawn inside a tile IS a member of that tile; no purely decorative nesting.
